# Operator Note — Arc Flash Incident at Induction Power Cabinet (see SB-1011)

This note summarizes immediate actions and ongoing precautions following the arc flash event reported at the induction power cabinet. See Safety Bulletin SB-1011 for full incident details, affected equipment, and engineering follow-up.

Immediate actions
- Stop work in the area and isolate the induction power cabinet per LOTO procedures until clearance is given by Electrical Maintenance.
- If anyone is injured, get medical attention immediately and notify Safety.
- Secure the area to prevent unauthorized access and post warning signage.

Inspection and verification
- Do not re-energize the cabinet until a qualified electrician has completed a documented inspection and repair.
- Verify that all protective devices, grounding, and enclosure integrity are evaluated and that root-cause findings are addressed.

Personal protective measures
- Use appropriate arc-rated apparel and face/eye protection when work around the cabinet resumes. Select PPE based on the hazard assessment documented in SB-1011.
- Maintain safe approach distances as defined in our electrical safety procedures.

Reporting and documentation
- Complete an incident report and attach to the SB-1011 investigation file.
- Supervisors must ensure affected operators attend the refresher briefing on arc flash awareness and cabinet-specific hazards.

Preventive actions
- Follow scheduled maintenance and housekeeping to prevent dust, moisture, and foreign objects in electrical enclosures.
- Report any abnormal smells, sounds, or visual indications from electrical equipment immediately.

For questions or to schedule a briefing, contact Electrical Maintenance or Safety.
